subject: Accounting
basis: IEB NSC examinations assess the same CAPS FET content as the national stream, so the prerequisite-knowledge skills defined in the CAPS tree transfer as-is: same skill, same content, same review format. Skill content is referenced, not duplicated - the CAPS file is the single source of truth for each skill's diagnostics, recap and exit check.
caveat: Each CAPS skill's importance.exam_weight block is derived from DBE ATP paper structures and does NOT transfer: IEB paper section weights come from the subject SAG and are pending SAG ingestion (../../exam_guidelines/sag_index.json). Until then, treat exam-weight claims as DBE-stream-only when serving IEB students.
